text:
Drake Batherson's point streak reached seven games before Buffalo shut him out on Wednesday. It was a nice run, highlighted by a three-goal, four-point night against the Rangers, and it leaves him with 18 points in 17 games on a Senators team that needs every one.

The goals deserve a skeptic's eye. Nine on 5.5 expected, shooting 23.1% against a likely range of 14 to 19, puts him in our due-to-cool group. The setup work is sturdier: Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 89th percentile among forwards in primary shot assists last season, and his heavy shot (89 mph, 89th percentile) is a real weapon on the power play, where Evolving-Hockey says most of his value came from last year.

He is also doing it on modest minutes, under 18 a night, which is why his 3.59 points per 60 looks so loud. Expect the shooting to cool and the playmaking to hold. Our projection has him near 79 points, not bad for a former 121st overall pick.
headline: Batherson's streak ended, the finishing may follow
